name: Mantis-Eval
intro: Mantis-Eval 是 Mantis 论文发布的留出多图理解测试集，由标注者使用 Google 搜索获取图像并人工编写必须联合理解多张图像的问题。它包含 217 条英文样本，平均每条 2.5 张图、最多 5 张图，同时覆盖多选题和简答题。
build_method: Google图像检索, 人工多图问题编写与整理
metric: 多选准确率, 简答准确率, 总体准确率
task_type: 多图像理解, 视觉问答
eval_feature: 跨图推理, 共指理解
scale: 217条测试样本；平均2.5张图，最多5张图
build_method_en: Google image search, manual multi-image question authoring and curation
intro_en: Mantis-Eval is the held-out multi-image understanding test set introduced by the Mantis paper. Annotators acquire images through Google Search and manually author questions that require joint understanding of multiple images. Its 217 English examples contain 2.5 images on average and at most five, with both multiple-choice and short-answer formats.
scale_en: 217 test examples; 2.5 images on average, maximum 5
metric_en: Multiple-choice accuracy, short-answer accuracy, overall accuracy

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2405.01483 and the official TIGER-AI-Lab/Mantis evaluator. The paper describes a manually curated held-out set of 217 examples whose images are acquired through Google Search and whose questions require understanding content across images. The diagram retains the reported 2.5-image average and five-image maximum without inventing an undocumented quality-control protocol. The evaluation path follows the official code: native multi-image inputs or horizontal merging for single-image baselines, option-letter or option-text parsing for multiple choice, final-answer phrase parsing for short answers, case-insensitive comparison, and separate plus overall accuracy.
